path.id: The rectangular scene contains people, flowers and architectural openings. Reducing the full composition would leave too much detail for a small icon.

Interlocking, layering and spatial filling describe the whole work. Fourfold rotation and mirroring help regularise the selected flower; they are construction tools rather than the extraction subject.
Auspicious meanings provide context. The visible cut-out shape offers a more direct starting point for this icon.
Select the four-part floral cut-out on the central tablecloth.
